mechanism: Atazanavir inhibits CYP3A4, significantly increasing chlorpromazine metabolism inhibition and elevating antipsychotic levels, while chlorpromazine may induce CYP3A4 and affect atazanavir exposure; additive QT prolongation risk exists.
action: Monitor QT interval via ECG, reduce chlorpromazine dose, consider alternative antipsychotic with lower QT risk, and monitor for chlorpromazine toxicity including extrapyramidal symptoms and arrhythmias.
